image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a black audio cassette tape. The image focuses on the central label area and the two tape spools. The label is pinkish-white with handwritten text in black marker that appears distorted and illegible. The plastic casing shows signs of wear and texture. The bottom edge reveals part of the tape access window.
